name: Python
tagline: Tested automation that calls APIs, SDKs and CLIs, then reports.

howItWorks.title: Environment
howItWorks.body:
A venv per project isolates dependencies.
requirements.txt pins exact versions.
The standard library covers most ops scripts: argparse, json, subprocess, pathlib.
Locked-down hosts install from an internal mirror.

howItWorks.title: API clients
howItWorks.body:
requests.Session reuses connections.
Every call sets timeout=; retries only for idempotent GET and HEAD.
Paginate until the page is empty.
Tokens come from the environment, never arguments.

howItWorks.title: SDKs and CLIs
howItWorks.body:
boto3 paginators list cloud resources read-only.
The Docker SDK inspects and prunes containers and images.
subprocess.run takes a list, check=True and a timeout.
Mutations hide behind --apply.

howItWorks.title: Dashboard pipeline
howItWorks.body:
Collectors pull version-control and project-management REST APIs.
Rows are normalised and upserted into PostgreSQL.
Apache Superset on Kubernetes queries PostgreSQL for charts.
The dashboard shows delivery and ticket flow in one place.

howItWorks.title: Scheduling and gates
howItWorks.body:
A systemd timer runs the oneshot service; Persistent=true catches missed runs.
The exit code feeds alerting.
CI runs ruff and pytest before every merge.
Logs go to journald, structured as JSON lines.

flow: systemd timer or CI job starts the script.
argparse reads options; secrets come from the environment.
Collectors call REST APIs, boto3 and Docker with timeouts.
Responses are paginated and normalised into records.
Records are upserted into PostgreSQL in one transaction.
Superset on Kubernetes queries PostgreSQL and renders charts.
Exit code and journald log feed alerting.

deploy.summary: Build a hardened ops collector: REST client, SDK reports, PostgreSQL upsert, systemd timer, CI gate, Superset.
prerequisites: Linux host with Python 3.10+ and python3-venv
PostgreSQL reachable, with a database and user
Kubernetes cluster and Helm 3 for Superset

steps.title: 1. Service user and pinned venv
steps.code:
sudo useradd --system --create-home --home-dir /opt/ops-toolkit --shell /usr/sbin/nologin opsbot
sudo -u opsbot python3 -m venv /opt/ops-toolkit/.venv
cat <<'EOF' | sudo -u opsbot tee /opt/ops-toolkit/requirements.txt
requests==2.32.3
boto3==1.35.36
docker==7.1.0
psycopg[binary]==3.2.3
pytest==8.3.3
ruff==0.7.1
EOF
sudo -u opsbot /opt/ops-toolkit/.venv/bin/pip install -r /opt/ops-toolkit/requirements.txt
steps.note: System user has no login shell. Bump pins deliberately.

steps.title: 2. Paginated REST client (client.py)
steps.code:
"""client.py: paginated REST client. API_URL and API_TOKEN come from the environment."""
import os
import requests
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry


def session() -> requests.Session:
    retry = Retry(total=3, backoff_factor=0.5, status_forcelist=(502, 503, 504),
                  allowed_methods=("GET", "HEAD"))
    s = requests.Session()
    s.mount("https://", HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry))
    s.headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + os.environ["API_TOKEN"]
    return s


def pages(path: str, per_page: int = 100):
    s, page = session(), 1
    while True:
        r = s.get(os.environ["API_URL"] + path, params={"page": page, "per_page": per_page}, timeout=10)
        r.raise_for_status()
        rows = r.json()
        if not rows:
            return
        yield from rows
        page += 1
steps.note: Timeout on every call. Retries only for GET and HEAD.

steps.title: 3. Docker SDK housekeeping (docker_tidy.py)
steps.code:
"""docker_tidy.py: report stopped containers and dangling images; prune only with --apply."""
import argparse
import docker

p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")
args = p.parse_args()
c = docker.from_env(timeout=10)
for ct in c.containers.list(all=True, filters={"status": "exited"}):
    print("exited:", ct.name, ct.image.tags)
for im in c.images.list(filters={"dangling": True}):
    print("dangling:", im.short_id)
if args.apply:
    print(c.containers.prune(filters={"until": "24h"}))
    print(c.images.prune(filters={"dangling": True}))
steps.note: Reports by default. Docker group access equals root, so scope it tightly.

steps.title: 4. Read-only boto3 report (ebs_report.py)
steps.code:
"""ebs_report.py: read-only list of unattached EBS volumes."""
import boto3

ec2 = boto3.client("ec2")
total = 0
for page in ec2.get_paginator("describe_volumes").paginate(
        Filters=[{"Name": "status", "Values": ["available"]}]):
    for v in page["Volumes"]:
        total += v["Size"]
        print(v["VolumeId"], v["Size"], "GiB", v["VolumeType"])
print("unattached GiB:", total)
steps.note: Needs ec2:DescribeVolumes only. Set AWS_PROFILE and AWS_REGION.

steps.title: 5. PostgreSQL upsert (collect.py)
steps.code:
"""collect.py: pull records from a REST API and upsert them into PostgreSQL."""
import os
import sys
import psycopg
from client import pages

DDL = """CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS work_items (
  id bigint PRIMARY KEY, title text, state text, created_at timestamptz, closed_at timestamptz)"""
UPSERT = """INSERT INTO work_items (id, title, state, created_at, closed_at)
VALUES (%(id)s, %(title)s, %(state)s, %(created_at)s, %(closed_at)s)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, state = EXCLUDED.state,
  closed_at = EXCLUDED.closed_at"""


def main() -> int:
    rows = [{k: r.get(k) for k in ("id", "title", "state", "created_at", "closed_at")}
            for r in pages("/work-items")]
    with psycopg.connect(os.environ["PG_DSN"]) as conn:  # one transaction, commits on exit
        conn.execute(DDL)
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.executemany(UPSERT, rows)
    print(f"upserted {len(rows)} rows")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
steps.note: Upsert makes reruns safe. Map the placeholder fields to your API.

steps.title: 6. systemd service and timer
steps.code:
sudo install -m 0600 -o root -g root /dev/null /etc/ops-toolkit.env
sudoedit /etc/ops-toolkit.env   # API_URL=<https://api.example.com/v1>  API_TOKEN=<token>  PG_DSN=<postgresql://user:pass@host/db>
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/ops-collect.service >/dev/null <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Collect ops data into PostgreSQL
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
User=opsbot
WorkingDirectory=/opt/ops-toolkit
EnvironmentFile=/etc/ops-toolkit.env
ExecStart=/opt/ops-toolkit/.venv/bin/python collect.py
TimeoutStartSec=300
NoNewPrivileges=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true
PrivateTmp=true
EOF
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/ops-collect.timer >/dev/null <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Run ops-collect every 15 minutes

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*:0/15
Persistent=true
RandomizedDelaySec=60

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
EOF
sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl enable --now ops-collect.timer
steps.note: Secrets live in a root-only env file. Replace placeholders in angle brackets.

steps.title: 7. Tests and CI gate
steps.code:
# test_client.py
import client


def test_pages_stops_on_empty(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("API_URL", "http://x")
    monkeypatch.setenv("API_TOKEN", "t")
    data = iter([[{"id": 1}], [{"id": 2}], []])

    class R:
        def __init__(self, rows): self.rows = rows
        def raise_for_status(self): pass
        def json(self): return self.rows

    class S:
        def get(self, *a, **k): return R(next(data))

    monkeypatch.setattr(client, "session", lambda: S())
    assert [r["id"] for r in client.pages("/x")] == [1, 2]

# run in CI:  ruff check . && python -m pytest -q
steps.note: Save as test_client.py. Run ruff and pytest as a pipeline stage.

steps.title: 8. Superset on Kubernetes
steps.code:
helm repo add superset https://apache.github.io/superset && helm repo update
helm install superset superset/superset --version <CHART_VERSION> -n superset --create-namespace -f values.yaml
kubectl -n superset rollout status deploy/superset
kubectl -n superset port-forward svc/superset 8088:8088
# Superset UI: Settings > Database Connections > + Database > PostgreSQL <SQLALCHEMY_URI>
steps.note: Set the chart version and metadata DB in values.yaml. Point the chart at PostgreSQL, not SQLite.

verify: systemctl list-timers ops-collect.timer shows the next elapse time.
systemctl show ops-collect -p Result -p ExecMainStatus reports success and 0.
psql "$PG_DSN" -c 'select count(*) from work_items' returns rows.
python -m pytest -q && ruff check . passes with no errors.
pitfalls: requests has no default timeout; a missing timeout= hangs the job forever.
pip into system Python breaks OS tooling; always use a venv.
shell=True with untrusted input is command injection; pass an argument list.
Tokens in arguments leak via ps and shell history; use an env file.
Plain INSERT duplicates rows on rerun; upsert on a primary key.
Docker group membership grants root; keep prune behind --apply.
Timer without Persistent=true skips runs missed while the host was down.
keyPoints: Every network call gets a timeout, bounded retries and an exit code.
Pin dependencies in a virtualenv; run the same on laptop, CI and host.
Read-only by default; mutate only behind an explicit --apply flag.
Collectors write to PostgreSQL; Superset turns the history into decisions.
quickDeploy: Create a venv and pin requirements
Write collectors for REST, boto3 and Docker
Run them from a hardened systemd timer
Gate changes with pytest and ruff in CI
osiNote: Speaks HTTPS to REST APIs; drives local sockets and CLIs.
production: Run as a dedicated user with a systemd-hardened unit.
Keep tokens in an env file, mode 0600, never in arguments.
Alert on non-zero exit and on stale last-success timestamps.
Upsert idempotently so reruns and backfills are safe.
Pin versions and run pytest plus ruff on every merge.
